reviews.text: Ethereum is the leading smart contract platform, transitioned to PoS in 2022. It hosts DeFi, NFTs, and L2s. In 2025, Danksharding boosts scalability. ETH is deflationary. It’s the cornerstone of Web3.

Ethereum is a blockchain platform on which decentralized dapps are built that can run smart contracts. It is also the native cryptocurrency ETH. Ethereum is a digital computer and infrastructure platform. Its basic structure: EVM (Ethereum Virtual Machine), chain smart contracts,ETH (fee). Ethereum is an intelligent computer system that will become even more valuable in the future. I would call it a quantum computer that can do everything from banking, art trading, money transfer and trade. I did not include a link like in other reports or write much detail because Ethereum has proven itself and is recognized and approved with the ETF entry.

Ethereum is the first and leading smart-contract platform and the original layer-1 for DeFi, NFTs and decentralized apps. After transitioning to Proof-of-Stake (Merge) to reduce its sustainability impact and drive institution adoption, its roadmap has focused on scalability, one of the top issues of the chain. The Dencun upgrade (Mar 2024) rolled out EIP-4844 (proto-danksharding), introducing blob transactions to cut Layer-2 fees. Pectra launched in May 2025, raising validator limits and improving account abstraction. Fusaka is expected in December 2025, adding PeerDAS data availability sampling and Verkle trees. Actually, most of the new activity on Ethereum happens on its L2s (Arbitrum, Optimism, Base, etc.), where average transaction costs were reduced to under $0.01. Ethereum’s massive developer community and network security (hundreds of thousands of validators) remain major strengths. Its co-founder Vitalik, is one of the most known people in the space. Ethereum foundation is hosting several community meetings all over the world, catching the attention of tech and non-tech people worldwide.

Ethereum is a highly secured layer 1 protocol that used proof of work consensus mechanism, but later upgraded to proof o f stake. Proposed in 2013 by Vitalik Buterin and launched in 2015 via a public crowdsale. Its core idea was a general-purpose blockchain, not just a currency. Ethereum introduced the concept of smart contract used to create decentralised applications (Dapp) and Ethereum Virtual Machine. The features of ethereum allows building of multiple protocols, scaling solutions and data availability solutions which rely on Ethereum robust security. Ethereum underwent multiple upgrades and the upcoming Fusaka Upgrade will be focusing on massive Data Scaling. Major upgrades on Ethereum are decided via a consensus process among the core developer teams, the Ethereum Foundation, and the community of validators and users reflecting a DAO nature of the governance.

Ethereum feels to me like the undeniable foundation of crypto. I rely on it constantly it hosts the largest DeFi NFT ecosystems and secures more value than anything else. Its network effects and security are unmatched, which is why I trust it for major applications. On the downside, it’s no secret it struggles with congestion; high demand still pushes gas fees through the roof at times, which is its biggest user pain point. But in terms of reputation and track record, it’s the standard.

Ethereum is the pioneering blockchain platform that introduced the concept of smart contracts, revolutionizing decentralized applications (dApps) and decentralized finance (DeFi). Since its launch in 2015, Ethereum has become the most widely used blockchain, powering a vast ecosystem of applications and digital assets. Ethereum's decentralized nature, along with its ongoing transition to Ethereum 2.0 (a proof-of-stake network), aims to address scalability and energy efficiency issues. Despite facing challenges such as high transaction fees and network congestion, Ethereum remains at the forefront of the blockchain space due to its strong community, developer tools, and vast network effect.
